app.name: FlatMeta
app.tagline: The world map you can own a piece of
app.description: Claim a plot of the real world, make it yours in seconds with AI, and get found by people and AI agents. Explore, quest and climb the leaderboards with your city.

hud.searchAi: Ask anything: “vegan cafés near the Thames”
hud.allDone: All quests done. Come back tomorrow!

claim.title: Claim land
claim.hint: Drag on the map to draw your plot. Each square is a cell.
claim.hintTouch: Tap one corner, then the opposite corner.
claim.zoomIn: Zoom in to see the cells
claim.freeExplain: Your first plot (up to 2×2 outside city centres) is on us.

auth.title: Sign in to FlatMeta
auth.subtitle: No password. We email you a 6-digit code.
auth.code: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}
auth.devHint: Test environment (email is off): your code is {code}. Tap to use it.

tour.s1b: Every glowing tile is a plot someone owns, or a showcase of how brands could use theirs. Zoom in to see the art.
tour.s2b: Places, brands, people, or plain questions like “surf schools in Rio”.
tour.s3b: Explore, like, wave and claim to level up. Your quests live here.
tour.s4b: Your first plot is free. Press Claim land, draw a square, done.

plot.showcaseNote: This sample plot shows how {brand} could use FlatMeta. It is not created, endorsed or affiliated with {brand}. Imagery is original and AI-generated.
plot.claimIt: Is this your organisation? Claim it
plot.dormant: This plot has been quiet for a while.

footer.made: Made for explorers, creators and local heroes.
